Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Ishita Ranade. I am a 32-year-old taxi driver living in Chennai. M/s Everest Traders gave me a cheque for ₹9,90,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 62055 23008 or email ishita.ranade@example.com.
